description: input-lock: Renovate reads every entry of a lock.json that has a datasource and moves its version; the input-lock Action then commits the new checksums to the same branch.

customManagers.description: input-lock's lock.json: one entry per downloaded file, `version` the pin, Renovate's lookup beside it. An entry without a datasource is not Renovate's: it is bumped by hand.
matchStrings: inputs.*[$exists(datasource)].{"depName": depName, "packageName": packageName, "currentValue": version, "datasource": datasource, "versioning": versioning, "extractVersion": extractVersion, "registryUrl": registryUrl}

packageRules.description: A lock entry's checksum arrives as a second commit on the branch, from the input-lock Action.
prBodyNotes: This bump moves an entry of an input-lock `lock.json`. The input-lock Action commits its new checksums to this branch within minutes of each push: merge once that commit is here, or once its run says no checksum had to change.
